subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom/phrase to fill in the blank.

My car ______ on the way to college yesterday.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"broke down"** means to stop functioning due to mechanical failure. (मशीन के खराब होने पर काम करना बंद करना)

 
 
• **Example: **The bus broke down on the way to the city.
 
 
 
• **"Broke down" **refers to a situation where a machine or vehicle stops working properly. (खराब हो जाना)
 
 
• **Example: **My car broke down on the way to college yesterday.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is- Option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Broke in **(घुसना): Enter a place forcibly or unauthorized.

 
 
• **Example:** Thieves broke in and stole the jewels.
 
 
 
• **Broke up **(टूट जाना): To end a relationship.
 
 
• **Example: **They broke up after five years of dating.
 
 
 
• **Broke out** (फूट पड़ना): To start suddenly (used for something unpleasant like a war, disease, etc.).
 
 
• **Example:** A fire broke out in the building last night.
